options.query: select rtrim(user_id) + '_' + rtrim(id) as id, report_name%l from sysreportprint where (user_id in (@@userId, 0) or form_type = 1) and controller = @xcontroller
select filename, description%l from sysreportrdlcform where status = 1 order by stt

query.text: if @action = 'NEW' select top 0 @@fields from sysreportprint2 a where 1=0 else select @@fields from sysreportprint2 a join sysreportprint b on a.user_id = b.user_id and a.id = b.id and a.controller = b.controller where (a.user_id in (@@userId, 0) or b.form_type = 1) and a.controller = @xcontroller and rtrim(a.user_id) + '_' + rtrim(a.id) = @xid

request.text: if exists(select 1 from sysreportprint where rtrim(user_id) + '_' + rtrim(id) = @xid and controller = @controller) select report_name as [!report_name], report_name2 as [!report_name2], report_file as [!report_file], form_type as [!form_type], portrait as [!portrait], title as [!title], title2 as [!title2], subtitle as [!subtitle], subtitle2 as [!subtitle2] from sysreportprint where rtrim(user_id) + '_' + rtrim(id) = @xid and controller = @controller else select '' as [!report_name], '' as [!report_name2], '0' as [!portrait], '' as [!title], '' as [!title2], '' as [!subtitle], '' as [!subtitle2], '0' as [!form_type]

if not exists(select 1 from sysreportprint where rtrim(user_id) + '_' + rtrim(id) = @xid and controller = @controller and user_id <> 0) select '$notEdit' as message else begin delete sysreportprint where rtrim(user_id) + '_' + rtrim(id) = @xid and controller = @controller delete sysreportprint2 where rtrim(user_id) + '_' + rtrim(id) = @xid and controller = @controller select '' as message end

loading.text: if @@admin = 0 select 'p.setDisabled(''form_type'', true)' as script else select '' as script

updating.text: update sysreportprint set report_name = @report_name, report_name2 = @report_name2, portrait = @portrait, report_file = @report_file, form_type = @form_type, title = @title, title2 = @title2, subtitle = @subtitle, subtitle2 = @subtitle2 where controller = @controller and rtrim(user_id) + '_' + rtrim(id) = @xid /*
